{{dablink|This article is about the real Lady Shiaine. For the [[Darkfriend]] who stole her identity, see [[Mili Skane]].}}
'''Shiaine Avarhin''' was a minor noble in [[Andor]] who once lived in [[Caemlyn]].{{ref/book|9|10}}

==History==
Shiaine Avarhin was the only daughter of Lord [[Willim Avarhin|Willim]] of House Avarhin, a minor and impoverished house of [[Andor]]. She was killed by [[Mili Skane]] and had her identity stolen by Mili.{{ref/book|9|10}}
